ImageDescription.value:
Mazda R360 coupé.

Mazda's first car - a two-door, four-seat coupé. Introduced in 1960, it features a short 69 inch (1753 mm) wheelbase and weighs just 838 lb (380 kg).

Powered by a rear-mounted air-cooled 356 cc V-twin engine putting out about 16 hp (12 kW) and 16 ft·lbf (22 Nm) of torque, the car is capable of about 52 mph (84 km/h). It has a 4-speed manual or two-speed automatic transmission, and rubber "springs" and torsion bars front and rear suspensions.

Credit.value: Mondial de l'Automobile 2010, Paris - France
